content.comment_body: When accessing Online Settings or Email Settings, I encounter an error stating 'Error loading panel,' which prevents me from entering any information.
Which version of [product_name] are you currently using?
Please refer to the following topic: SMTP panel failed to load.
Install the update to [product_name] [version_no] and also update the firmware to [version_no]. The update is available at [url].

analysis.insight_summary: Users are facing a critical error ('Error loading panel') when trying to configure Online or Email Settings, making it impossible to input the necessary data. This issue seems associated with certain software and firmware versions, and may be resolved through updating both.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to seamlessly access and modify email configuration settings through the Online Settings feature without encountering any errors.
